# CIDEX 2024 — 星逻智能科技（苏州）有限公司 (Skysys Intelligent Technology (SuZhou) Co., Ltd) — booth 2108

## Ringkasan

星逻智能成立于 2017 年，专注于无人机人工智能领域，是国内头部的低空智能化系 统供应商，主营产品包含适应全场景的无人机充电机库、无人机自动驾驶系统、巡检软 件及智能机器人。 Founded in 2017, Skysys focuses on the field of UAV artificial intelligence, and is the head low-altitude intelligent system supplier in China, with its main products containing UAV charging hangars adapted to the whole scenario, UAV autopilot systems, inspection software and intelligent robots.
